prompt: Reply to a customer who reports paying twice for one €20 order. The support timeline confirms one settled payment and one pending authorization for the same order. Team policy: a pending authorization is not refundable; escalate to billing if both entries settle. No release timeline has been confirmed. Do not ask for payment details. Return only JSON. Fields: disposition (explain_pending, refund_pending, or escalate_now), refundable_now (boolean), escalate_if_both_settle (boolean), and reply (brief customer-facing text).
expected_output: Structured disposition plus a customer-facing reply. Review the reply separately for clarity, unsupported promises and safe handling of payment data.
assertions: Escalation is conditional on both entries settling.
